messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — SEV2 — embeddings-queue-eu high queue length + 5xx spike. Incident ID: PD-65721. https://pagerduty.example/PD-65721

pagerbot: pd: page fired -> PD-65721; service=embedder-eu; symptoms=queue_len>2000, 5xx_rate_up; suggested runbook=embeddings-queue-runbook v2 :rotating_light:

Maya Chen: Acked via PD, I'm on call. Starting triage now. @Tim O'Connor can you pull infra metrics for embedder-eu?

Tim O'Connor: looking at metrics: enqueue rate jumped ~2.8x at 02:14 UTC. Worker 5xx spike concentrated on embedder-v2 pods. P50 latency ~3x baseline, P95 degraded. dashboard: https://grafana.example/d/embeds

Lin Zhao: fwiw there was a small kvcache tuning deploy to eu earlier at 02:12 — might be related. logs show increased eviction rate right after.

Raj Patel: if kvcache is thrashing we should rollback the flag. Preparing rollback now in case. @Maya please assign mitigation ownership and customer comms.

Maya Chen: I'm assigning mitigation to Raj (taking lead on rollback). I'll own customer comms. Handoff noted.

Raj Patel: rolling back kvcache tune flag on embedder-eu now. command: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/embedder-eu KVCACHE_TUNE=stable
kubectl rollout restart deploy/embedder-eu
```

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated for deployment/embedder-eu by Raj Patel — rollback to KVCACHE_TUNE=stable (pods: 6 -> restarting).

Raj Patel: pods restarting, waiting on readiness.

Tim O'Connor: pods coming back up, health checks green. 5xx rate is dropping — queue len trending down from 2.1k -> 400 in the last 3 mins.

Maya Chen: initial customer impact assessment: some API keys encountered elevated error rates for ~7 minutes (02:14–02:21 UTC). Notifying CS. @Liz Harmon please notify top affected accounts with status update.

Liz Harmon: pinged top 3 affected customers via email and slack template. noted they saw intermittent 502s. Will escalate if they reply. Template used: "We're investigating increased embed errors, mitigation in progress — will update in 15min."

Nora Singh: collecting request traces and logs for affected API keys. Found repeated 502s with upstream error from embedder-v2 process: 
```
ERROR embedder/thread-12: upstream read failed: EOF at api/request.go:243
stack: runtime.go:45 -> embed_handler.go:210
```
Attaching trace IDs: trace-09a3, trace-09b7.

Tim O'Connor: increased autoscaler buffer applied temporarily (+2 replicas) to handle residual burst. Command: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/embedder-eu --replicas=8 -n inference
```

Maya Chen: monitoring now. Thanks Raj/Tim/Nora. Leaving thread open for 30m of stability. If stable for 30m we'll close and file follow-ups.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-65721 acknowledged by Maya Chen — escalation paused.

Maya Chen: Incident update — mitigation successful. Impact window approx 02:14–02:23 UTC. Root cause: kvcache tuning flag caused eviction thrash under burst traffic, leading to increased 5xx and queue buildup. Action items: 1) keep kvcache flag reverted in EU until further testing, 2) add canary gating for kvcache tuning rollouts, 3) add alert correlating kvcache_eviction_rate -> queue_len. I'll file the follow-up ticket and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Raj Patel: filed infra ticket INF-2894 for kvcache rollout gating and canary.

Alex G: quick note for playbook — add explicit step to check recent kvcache deploys in runbook, saved as PR to runbook repo.

Maya Chen: final: closing after 30m stable. Thanks everyone for fast ack and rollback.

Raj Patel: marking this thread for postmortem and handoff to infra team.
